metric: Whole supervisor T0 to observed transport settlement, including post-terminal cleanup when timeout. A killed sample is right-censored for successful completion; its settlement is not a successful latency.
quantiles: p90 omitted: n=5 per case cannot meaningfully characterize tails.
cpuCaveat: Process CPU sums all threads and can exceed elapsed time. No subtraction estimates scheduler delay; no observer-overhead subtraction is applied.
